name: crawl-readiness
description: Check whether AI crawlers can read a website and what its access policy allows, whether a page permits an AI use, generate llms.txt, robots.txt and JSON-LD, and read your Answer Analysis.
long_description: Nine tools that call the live Crawl Readiness service. Five work without an account: score a site 0-100 against 50+ AI crawlers with a prioritized fix list, validate JSON-LD structured data, audit robots.txt line by line, compare what people see with what AI crawlers receive, and check whether a page's published signals (robots.txt, Content-Signal, Content-Usage, RSL, TDM, ai.txt, noai) permit search, answers, training or agent action, with what the server did when asked and a signed receipt. A free API key unlocks three generators (llms.txt, an AI-crawler-aware robots.txt, JSON-LD schema) and a read-only view of your Answer Analysis: whether live AI search (Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) named your brand for the questions your customers ask, against competitors, over time.

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Score a site 0-100 against 50+ AI crawlers, with a prioritized fix list.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Audit the JSON-LD structured data on a URL.

tools.name: validate_robots
tools.description: Audit a robots.txt line by line, with AI-crawler coverage.

tools.name: check_content_parity
tools.description: Compare what people see with what AI crawlers receive from a page.

tools.name: check_permission
tools.description: Ask whether a page may be used for search, answers, training or agent action, from the signals it publishes; signed receipt.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Crawl a site and produce an llms.txt file (API key).

tools.name: generate_robots_txt
tools.description: Produce an AI-crawler-aware robots.txt, merged into an existing one (API key).

tools.name: generate_schema
tools.description: Produce Organization, WebSite and Article JSON-LD (API key).

tools.name: get_monitor_trend
tools.description: Read your Answer Analysis: whether live AI search named the brand for the questions its customers ask, versus competitors, over time (API key).

crawl_readiness_api_key.title: Crawl Readiness API key
crawl_readiness_api_key.description: Optional. The four audit tools and the permission check work without it. A free key from https://www.crawlreadiness.com/dashboard unlocks the three generators and the Answer Analysis read.
